function.name: plan_route
function.description: Finds places based on user preferences and calculates actual travel time. Use this to suggest locations and build itineraries. IMPORTANT: For the first stop, the origin is the user's current city/location. For multi-stop plans, the origin MUST be the exact address of the PREVIOUS stop to calculate accurate sequential travel times.

query.description: The type of place, vibe, or semantic search term (e.g., 'quiet specialty coffee', 'sushi restaurant', 'luxury mall').

origin.description: The full address of the starting point. This is REQUIRED. If this is step 2 of an itinerary, pass the address of step 1 here.

travelMode.description: The user's preferred mode of transportation. Defaults to DRIVE if not specified.

maxTimeMinutes.description: The maximum travel time in minutes the user is willing to spend. Leave blank if the user doesn't specify a time limit.
